reference_evidence_set.rationale: The 40-case coverage target was aspirational rather than a hard evaluation gate. These 30 cases have passed fixed-test-split membership, source-first verification, and the corrected content-alignment gate after the identifier-collision and self-match corrections.

E1_E2_outcome_prediction.population: eligible cases in the full frozen ILDC test split

E3_E4_evidence_citation_grounding_proven.population: frozen source-verified answer-key-covered subset of the ILDC test split

E3_E4_outcome_prediction.reason: The frozen E3/E4 retrieval-and-evidence pipeline does not emit outcome labels; outcome prediction remains an E1/E2 measure.
